root@f7af256768ff:/app# cat > /tmp/decode.py << 'EOF'
> import re, struct
> data = {}
> with open('/tmp/rodata.txt') as f:
>     for line in f:
>         m = re.match(r'\s*([0-9a-f]+)\s+((?:[0-9a-f]{8}\s*)*)', line)
>         if not m: continue
>         addr = int(m.group(1),16)
>         hexs = m.group(2).replace(' ','')
>         b = bytes.fromhex(hexs)
>         for i in range(len(b)):
>             data[addr+i] = b[i]
> addrs = sorted(data)
> min_a, max_a = addrs[0], addrs[-1]
> allb = bytes(data[a] for a in range(min_a, max_a+1))
> base = min_a
> print(f'range {min_a:#x}..{max_a:#x}')
> print('Doubles:')
> for off in range(0, len(allb)-7, 8):
>     a = base+off
>     d = struct.unpack('<d', allb[off:off+8])[0]
>     print(f'  {a:#x}: {d!r}')
> print('Floats:')
> for off in range(0, len(allb)-3, 4):
>     a = base+off
>     fv = struct.unpack('<f', allb[off:off+4])[0]
>     print(f'  {a:#x}: {fv!r}')
> EOF
